==Descriptions==
'''Unreleased Tournament Map''' is a map that was originally intended to release with the scrapped Tournaments. It was later stated that the map would instead debut as a [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] map, but this also ultimately never occurred.<ref>https://x.com/LilDisquit/status/1286386782016217088</ref>

==Design & Path==
'''Unreleased Tournament Map''' is a hell-like map with red stone terrain and with lava flowing through a lavafall and a river. The area contains a giant castle with neon orange windows and multiple towers on it. The castle is surrounded by a wall. This wall is accessed by a path protected by multiple watchtowers.

The path appears to start at a cave and end at the castle. It takes a long route through the map, going across many bridges to avoid the lava lakes and rivers.
